title: Compare the fixed twelve generator form to the full gradient norm
statement: Combining sine/cosine opposite shifts gives ||B_ij^c v||2^2+||B_ij^s v||2^2=2pi^2 sum_k k_i^2[||P_(k+e_j)v_k||^2+||P_(k-e_j)v_k||^2]. For integer k_i!=0,j!=i, the angle betweenk andk+/-e_j has cosine>=1/sqrt2, so each projection preserves>=half squared norm for vectors perpendicular tok. Sum the two transverse j and threei: ||gradv||2^2<=sum_(i!=j)(||B_ij^c v||2^2+||B_ij^s v||2^2)<=2||gradv||2^2. Zero shifts with k_i=0 contributezero. Thus the family has no common nonconstant kernel. This is a quadratic-form fact, not a mixing rate or controller theorem.
